resources.string:
SceneRemote controls OBS Studio over obs-websocket 5 on your local network.

The connection closes when you leave this app, and it also closes if Android kills the app. SceneRemote runs no background service. Your stream and recording keep running in OBS. When you come back, the app connects again if it is still in memory.

obs-websocket is not encrypted, so SceneRemote only connects to private, loopback or link-local addresses. Public addresses are refused because the password challenge would cross the internet.

A saved password is encrypted on this phone with a key held in the Android Keystore. It is never shown, logged or sent anywhere, and it is used only for the address and port it was saved with. obs-websocket has no server identity, so another machine holding that same address on a different network would still receive the login answer. There are no ads, accounts or analytics.
